Automatically enters Stage 1 below 75% health, Stage 2 below 50%, and Stage 3 below 25%.
Requires awakened Goru. The current stage follows your health, including when healing.
Normal: Treasury of Uruk, ZASSHU, Uta Darunaki.
Stage 1: Gate of Babylon, Chains of Heaven, Uta Darunaki.
Stage 2: Gate of Babylon EX, Chains of Heaven: Enkidu, Ea: Winds of Rapture.
Stage 3: Gate of Babylon EX, Enkidu: Absolute Bind, Ea: Enuma Elish.
